name: BytePlus Volcengine Sandbox
description: Volcengine cloud container sandbox backend for OpenClaw agents. Provisions ECS instances, connects via SSH, and mirrors the workspace for secure code execution.

image.description: Container/AMI image ID or name for sandbox instances (e.g. cr.volces.com/my-org/sandbox:latest)

vpcId.description: VPC ID for the sandbox instance (required for ECS)

subnetId.description: Subnet ID for the sandbox instance (required for ECS)

securityGroupId.description: Security group ID (must allow inbound SSH on port 22)

keyPairName.description: Pre-created ECS key pair name; public key must be registered in Volcengine console

sshPrivateKey.description: PEM-encoded private key matching keyPairName, used for SSH authentication

sshUser.description: SSH login user inside the sandbox instance

remoteWorkspaceDir.description: Remote workspace directory path on the sandbox instance

containerPrefix.description: Prefix for instance names created by this plugin

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for instance creation to reach Running state

idleHours.description: Delete instances idle for this many hours (0 = disabled)

maxAgeDays.description: Delete instances older than this many days (0 = disabled)
